questions.question: ref() vs reactive() trong Vue 3 Composition API?

options.A: ref: any value (primitive+object), access với .value. reactive: objects only, direct access

questions.explanation: ref(0): wraps in {value: 0}. Template auto-unwrap → không cần .value. reactive({count:0}): cannot reassign root object, lose reactivity khi destructure. Prefer ref for most cases (simpler, consistent).

questions.question: v-if vs v-show trong Vue?

options.A: v-if: conditionally render/remove DOM element. v-show: always render, toggle CSS display
options.C: v-show nhanh hơn v-if trong mọi trường hợp

questions.explanation: v-if: destroy/recreate DOM → lifecycle hooks run. v-show: CSS display toggle → element always in DOM. v-if: tốt khi rarely toggle. v-show: tốt khi frequently toggle. v-if với v-for: v-if ưu tiên cao hơn (Vue 3).
